info.title: Village Storefront API
info.description:
**Multi-tenant SaaS ecommerce platform API**

Village Storefront provides a comprehensive REST API for managing online stores,
products, orders, payments, and consignment vendors. Each merchant operates an
isolated store accessible via subdomain (storename.villagecompute.com) or custom domain.

## Tenant Resolution

The API automatically resolves the current tenant from the HTTP `Host` header:
- Subdomain: `storename.villagecompute.com` → tenant with subdomain "storename"
- Custom domain: `shop.merchant.com` → tenant with verified custom domain

All API operations are automatically scoped to the resolved tenant. No explicit
tenant ID parameter is required in requests.

## Authentication

The API supports two authentication methods:

1. **JWT Bearer Tokens** (for user sessions):
   - Access token (15 min expiry) + Refresh token (30 day expiry)
   - Obtain via `/api/v1/auth/login`, refresh via `/api/v1/auth/refresh`
   - Includes `tenant_id`, `sub` (user ID), and `roles` claims

2. **API Keys** (for server-to-server integrations):
   - Long-lived tokens scoped to tenant + permissions
   - Managed via admin dashboard at `/admin/settings/api-keys`
   - Pass via `X-API-Key` header

## Versioning

- URL-based versioning: `/api/v1`, `/api/v2` (breaking changes)
- Deprecation policy: 12-month notice, marked with `deprecated: true`

## Error Handling

All errors follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format. See `ProblemDetails` schema.

## Rate Limiting

Rate limits vary by authentication method and endpoint category:
- Public endpoints: 100 requests/min per IP
- Authenticated endpoints: 1000 requests/min per user
- Headless API: 5000 requests/min per API key

Rate limit headers included in all responses:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Request limit per window
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Remaining requests in window
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Unix timestamp when window resets

## Custom Extensions

This specification uses custom `x-*` extensions to document additional metadata:

**x-tenant-scope** - Indicates tenant context requirement:
- `none`: No tenant context required (system health checks)
- `required`: Tenant must be resolved from Host header
- `optional`: Tenant context optional (platform admin endpoints)

**x-feature-flags** - Array of feature flag keys that must be enabled. Empty array means no flags required.

Example: `x-feature-flags: ["headless.api.enabled", "advanced_inventory.enabled"]`

**x-rate-limit** - Rate limit configuration:
- `limit`: Maximum requests per window
- `window`: Time window (e.g., "60s", "1h")
- `scope`: Rate limit scope (ip, user, client)
- `note`: Optional explanation for non-standard limits

Example:
```yaml
x-rate-limit:
  limit: 1000
  window: 60s
  scope: user
```

**x-required-scopes** - OAuth/permission scopes that must be granted to call the operation.
Declare scopes for OAuth client credentials (`catalog:read`) or JWT role-based permissions
(`admin.catalog:write`). Empty array means no scopes required (public endpoint).

Example:
```yaml
x-required-scopes:
  - catalog:read
  - orders:write
```

These extensions are used for generating rate-limit middleware configuration and documenting feature flag dependencies.

servers.description: API v1 (relative URL, resolves to current host)
Example tenant subdomain (replace 'storename' with actual subdomain)

tags.name: System
tags.description: System health and platform metadata endpoints (public, no auth required)

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
User authentication and session management. Supports JWT token-based auth
with access/refresh token flow. See ADR-001 for tenant context injection.

tags.name: Storefront
tags.description:
Customer-facing storefront operations (product browsing, cart, checkout).
These endpoints power the Qute-templated storefront UI and can also be
used by headless/mobile clients.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description:
Store administration endpoints (product management, order fulfillment, settings).
Requires `admin` or `vendor` role. Powers the Vue.js admin dashboard at `/admin/*`.

tags.name: Vendor
tags.description:
Consignor-facing vendor portal endpoints for viewing intake items, payout batches, and account details.
Requires a vendor JWT with a `consignor_id` claim.

tags.name: Headless
tags.description:
Headless commerce API for custom frontend implementations. Supports cart
operations, checkout flows, and order management via API keys. Optimized
for high-throughput integrations.

tags.name: Platform
tags.description:
Platform-level administration (tenant management, billing, system config).
Restricted to platform administrators only. Not accessible to individual
store owners.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description:
Product catalog operations including products, variants, categories, and collections.
Supports both storefront (public/customer-facing) and admin scopes. All operations
are tenant-scoped and enforce RLS isolation.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description:
Multi-location inventory management including locations, transfers, adjustments,
and stock level tracking. Admin-only operations with tenant isolation and
audit logging for all stock movements.

tags.name: Shipping
tags.description:
Carrier rate shopping, label purchase, and address validation endpoints for storefront
checkout and fulfillment services. Requires tenant-scoped authentication and rate
limit coordination with carrier APIs.

get.description:
Returns the service health status. Used by Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes.
No authentication required.

200.description: Service is healthy and ready to accept requests

post.summary: Authenticate user and obtain JWT tokens
post.description:
Authenticates a user (customer, admin, or vendor) and returns access + refresh tokens.
Tenant context is automatically resolved from the Host header before authentication.

**Token Claims:**
- `sub`: User ID (UUID)
- `tenant_id`: Tenant ID (UUID)
- `roles`: Array of role strings (admin, customer, vendor)
- `exp`: Expiration timestamp

**Session Logging:**
All login attempts are logged to the database for audit/compliance purposes.

x-rate-limit.note: Strict rate limit to prevent brute-force attacks

post.summary: Refresh access token using refresh token
post.description:
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair.
Refresh tokens are single-use; the old refresh token is invalidated upon successful refresh.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token obtained from login

post.description:
Logs out the current user by invalidating the refresh token.
Access tokens cannot be invalidated (stateless JWT), but expire in 15 minutes.

get.description:
Returns metadata about the currently resolved tenant based on the Host header.
Useful for headless clients to verify tenant context and retrieve theme settings.

**No authentication required** - tenant resolution happens before authentication.

404.description: No tenant found for this domain/subdomain

get.description:
Returns the active theme configuration including colors, typography, spacing, and other design tokens.
Used by storefront templates (Qute) and headless clients to maintain brand consistency.

**Caching:** This endpoint includes aggressive caching headers (24h). Changes to theme require cache invalidation.

404.description: No theme configured for this tenant

get.description:
Returns complete theme configuration including metadata, versioning, and design tokens.
Admin-only endpoint for theme management interface.

patch.description:
Partially updates theme tokens (colors, typography, spacing, etc.).
Only specified fields are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.

**Side effects:**
- Increments theme version number
- Triggers cache invalidation for `/theme/tokens` endpoint
- Logs audit event with actor and changes

get.description:
Returns paginated list of inventory levels across all locations.
Supports filtering by variant, location, or low-stock status.

parameters.name: lowStock
parameters.description: Filter to items below low-stock threshold

get.summary: Get aggregated inventory summary for variant
get.description:
Returns total inventory across all locations for a specific variant,
including breakdown by location.

get.summary: Get inventory level for variant at specific location
get.description: Returns detailed inventory level for a variant at a specific location.

patch.description:
Updates inventory quantities for a variant at a specific location.
Used for corrections, cycle counts, and threshold adjustments.

**Audit trail:** All adjustments are logged with reason and actor.

get.description:
Returns paginated list of active products for the current tenant. Supports:
- Filtering by category, collection, price range, availability
- Sorting by name, price, created date, popularity
- Search by product name, SKU, description
- Tenant-scoped results with automatic RLS enforcement

**Authentication:** Optional (public catalog browsing, auth required for customer-specific pricing)

**Rate Limiting:** 100 req/min (anonymous), 1000 req/min (authenticated)

**Feature Flags:** Respects `catalog.search.enabled` and tenant-level kill switches

x-rate-limit.note: Anonymous requests clamped to 100/min per IP

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Minimum price filter (in tenant's default currency)

403.description: Feature flag disabled (catalog.search.enabled is false for tenant)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for catalog listing

get.description:
Returns full product details including variants, pricing, inventory, images.
Public endpoint (no auth required for browsing). Tenant-scoped with RLS enforcement.

**Rate Limiting:** 100 req/min (anonymous), 1000 req/min (authenticated)
List all categories for the tenant, ordered by display order.

post.description: Create a new catalog category for the tenant.

get.description: Retrieve the full definition of a single category.

put.description: Replace category fields (name, codes, hierarchy metadata).

delete.description: Soft-delete a category and hide it from storefront navigation.

get.description: List collections with optional status filtering and pagination.

post.description: Create a manual or automated collection for merchandising.

get.description: Fetch a specific collection including selection rules and merchandising metadata.

put.description: Update collection rules, merchandising metadata, or publishing state.

delete.description: Archive a collection and remove it from storefront navigation.

post.description:
Enqueues a background job to import product catalog data from a CSV file.
The job processes asynchronously and returns immediately with a job ID.

**Feature Flags:** Requires `catalog.import-export.enabled`
**Rate Limiting:** 10 req/hour (to prevent abuse)

400.description: Invalid request (missing fileLocation or invalid options)

post.description:
Enqueues a background job to export product catalog data to CSV format.
The job processes asynchronously and returns immediately with a job ID.
Download URL will be provided via webhook or job status polling.

**Feature Flags:** Requires `catalog.import-export.enabled`
**Rate Limiting:** 10 req/hour

get.description:
Returns the option axes and variant listings for a product. Used by
storefront configurators to build size/color pickers. Tenant-scoped with
feature flag enforcement.

**Feature Flags:** Requires `catalog.variant-matrix.enabled`
**Rate Limiting:** 100 req/min (anonymous), 1000 req/min (authenticated)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for variant matrix lookups

post.description:
Calculates order totals including:
- Line item subtotals (product price × quantity)
- Discounts (promo codes, customer-specific pricing)
- Taxes (based on shipping address)
- Shipping costs (based on carrier rates)

**Idempotent:** Safe to call multiple times with same cart state.
Does not create order or charge payment method.

400.description: Invalid cart state (out of stock, invalid promo code, etc.)

post.description:
Atomically:
1. Validates cart and inventory availability
2. Creates order record with PENDING_PAYMENT status
3. Charges payment method via Stripe PaymentIntent
4. Reduces inventory and reserves items
5. Updates order to PAID status
6. Clears customer cart
7. Enqueues fulfillment job

**Idempotent:** Uses `X-Idempotency-Key` header to prevent duplicate orders
if client retries due to network failure. Duplicate requests within 60 minutes
return cached response with 200 OK (not 201).

**Feature Flag:** Requires `checkout.order-creation.enabled` to be true.
Returns 503 if disabled.

**Requires authentication:** Must be logged-in customer or use valid API key.

x-rate-limit.note: Lower limit due to payment processing and inventory locking overhead

201.description: Order successfully created and payment charged

Location.description: URL of the created order resource

400.description: Invalid request (validation errors, out of stock, etc.)

409.description: Duplicate idempotency key (order already created or in-flight request)

503.description: Service unavailable (checkout feature disabled via feature flag)

post.description:
Fetches real-time shipping rates from configured carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx).
Results are cached for 15 minutes to meet performance targets per Architecture §3.0.

If carrier APIs are unavailable, returns fallback table rates with `fallbackUsed: true`.

**Correlation Tracking:** Pass `X-Correlation-ID` header for distributed tracing.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID for request tracing

post.description:
Validates a shipping address using carrier validation APIs (USPS, UPS, FedEx).
Returns normalized/corrected address with validation status.

Falls back to returning original address if all carriers are unavailable.

post.summary: Create shipping label for an order
post.description:
Creates a shipping label for a confirmed order using the specified carrier.
Returns tracking number and label URL (PDF or image).

**Requires authentication:** Admin or API key with shipping permissions.

get.description: Retrieves shipping label details including tracking number and label URL.
Lists shipping profiles for the current tenant including origin addresses and enabled carriers.

post.description: Creates a new shipping profile containing carrier credentials and default origin address.

get.description: Retrieve one shipping profile including carrier credentials and origins.

put.description: Update carrier credentials, origins, or rules on an existing profile.

delete.description: Delete a shipping profile that is no longer needed.

post.description: Mark a profile as the default origin/carrier bundle for checkout.

get.description:
Retrieves full order details including line items, payment status, and shipment tracking.

**Authentication:** Customers can only access their own orders. Admin/API keys can access all tenant orders.

404.description: Order not found or unauthorized access

get.description:
Returns paginated list of orders for the authenticated customer.
Admin users see all tenant orders.

Returns paginated list of all orders for the current tenant with advanced filtering.
Requires `admin` role.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by order number, customer email, or customer name

get.description:
Retrieves full order details with administrative metadata.
Requires `admin` role.

patch.description:
Partially update order details (notes, tags, status transitions).
Requires `admin` role. Some status transitions may be restricted based on order state.

400.description: Invalid request (illegal status transition, validation errors)

post.description:
Cancels an order and initiates refund if payment was captured.
Requires `admin` role.

Creates a refund for the order (full or partial).
Requires `admin` role.

restockItems.description: Whether to return items to inventory

400.description: Invalid refund request (exceeds order total, etc.)

post.description:
Creates a return authorization for an order allowing customer to return items.
Requires `admin` role.

**Workflow:**
1. Admin initiates return with line items and reasons
2. Return authorization created in REQUESTED status
3. Admin approves return (separate endpoint)
4. Items physically received and inspected
5. Inventory restocked based on decision
6. Refund issued if applicable

400.description: Invalid return request (invalid line items, quantities exceed ordered)

post.description:
Receives webhook events from Stripe (payment confirmations, disputes, refunds).

**Security:** Validates Stripe signature via `Stripe-Signature` header.
Idempotent via `event.id` deduplication in database.

schema.description: Stripe event payload (varies by event type)

post.description:
Receives shipment tracking updates from shipping carriers (delivered, in transit, exception).

**Security:** Validates carrier-specific signature/token.
Idempotent via tracking number + event timestamp deduplication.

get.description:
Returns the active cart for the authenticated user or guest session.
Includes all line items with calculated totals.

**Authentication:** Optional - guest carts tracked via session, user carts via JWT.
Provide the `X-Session-Id` header (or rely on the `vs_session` cookie issued by the API) to continue a guest cart.

delete.description:
Removes all line items from the cart. The cart entity itself remains
and can be reused for future items.

post.description:
Adds a product variant to the cart with specified quantity.
If the variant already exists in the cart, the quantities are merged.

**Price Snapshot:** The current variant price is captured at add-to-cart
time to prevent cart total changes when product prices are updated.

**Optimistic Locking:** Returns HTTP 409 if concurrent modification detected.
**Guest Session:** Provide `X-Session-Id` or use the `vs_session` cookie to add to the same anonymous cart.

400.description: Validation error (invalid variant, negative quantity, etc.)

patch.description:
Updates the quantity of a specific cart line item.

**Optimistic Locking:** Returns HTTP 409 if concurrent modification detected.

get.description: Returns items that were moved out of the active cart via the "save for later" action.

post.description: Moves the specified cart line item into the saved-for-later collection.
Re-adds a saved-for-later line item back into the active cart.

delete.description: Removes the saved-for-later entry without restoring it to the cart.

get.description:
Returns the currently active loyalty program configuration for the tenant inferred from the `Host` header.
Responds with `404` if the tenant has not configured a program yet.

Returns the loyalty membership record (balance, lifetime stats, tier) for the specified user. Requires the
caller to be authenticated as the same tenant.

404.description: User is not enrolled in the loyalty program

post.description:
Idempotently enrolls the specified user in the tenant's active loyalty program. Returns the existing membership
record if the user was already enrolled.

400.description: Enrollment failed (user not found or program disabled)

post.summary: Redeem loyalty points for a discount
post.description:
Redeems points from the user's balance for discounts during checkout. Enforces program-level minimum/maximum
thresholds and requires the `X-Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.

400.description: Redemption failed (insufficient balance, invalid thresholds, or missing idempotency key)

get.summary: List loyalty transactions for a member
get.description: Returns the immutable ledger entries for the specified user's loyalty account ordered by `createdAt DESC`.

400.description: User is not enrolled in the loyalty program

get.description:
Returns the loyalty program configuration for the current tenant, including disabled programs. Requires an admin
JWT.

404.description: No configuration exists for this tenant

put.description:
Creates or updates the loyalty program configuration for the tenant. Setting `enabled` to `false` leaves the
configuration in place but disables accrual/redemption.

post.description:
Adjusts a member's balance manually for customer service or remediation scenarios. Supports positive and
negative adjustments while preventing negative balances.

400.description: Adjustment failed (user not enrolled or invalid point amount)

post.description:
Returns the current balance and status of a gift card by its code. Does not require authentication,
allowing customers to check balances before redemption. Code lookups use secure SHA-256 hashing.

404.description: Gift card not found or expired

post.description:
Applies a gift card to an order, deducting the specified amount from the card's balance.
Supports partial redemption. Requires the `X-Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.

400.description: Redemption failed (insufficient balance, expired card, or missing idempotency key)

get.description: Returns the immutable ledger entries for the specified gift card ordered by `createdAt DESC`.
Returns a paginated list of gift cards with optional filtering by status. Requires admin role.

post.summary: Admin - issue a new gift card
post.description:
Creates a new gift card with a secure randomly generated code. Can be used for promotional
purposes or customer service remediation.

get.description: Returns full details of a gift card including transaction history and metadata.

patch.summary: Admin - update gift card status or balance
patch.description: Allows admins to cancel gift cards, adjust balances, or update expiration dates.

get.summary: Get store credit balance for user
get.description: Returns the current store credit balance and account status for the specified user.

404.description: Store credit account not found for user

post.description:
Applies store credit to an order, deducting the specified amount from the user's balance.
Requires the `X-Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.

400.description: Redemption failed (insufficient balance or missing idempotency key)

get.description: Returns the immutable ledger entries for the specified user's store credit account ordered by `createdAt DESC`.
Returns a paginated list of store credit accounts with optional filtering by status.

post.description:
Adjusts a user's store credit balance manually for refunds, customer service, or promotional purposes.
Supports positive and negative adjustments while preventing negative balances.

400.description: Adjustment failed (invalid amount or would result in negative balance)

post.summary: Admin - convert gift card balance to store credit
post.description:
Moves the remaining balance from a gift card to a user's store credit account.
This is useful for customer service scenarios or when a customer wants to consolidate balances.

400.description: Conversion failed (gift card has no balance or user account issues)

404.description: Gift card or user not found

Returns paginated list of all tenants with status, creation date, and billing info.
**Restricted to platform administrators only** (not accessible to store owners).

post.description:

get.description:
**OAuth Scope Required:** `catalog:read`

List active products with optional search and pagination. Designed for headless/custom
frontends consuming the catalog API.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id (configurable per OAuth client)

**Caching:** Search results are cached for 5 minutes. Cache is invalidated on catalog updates.

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled` (tenant-scoped)

**Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow via HTTP Basic Auth.
Pass client_id:client_secret as Authorization header.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query (searches product names and descriptions)

403.description: OAuth client does not have catalog:read scope or feature disabled

get.description:
**OAuth Scope Required:** `catalog:read`

Retrieve detailed product information including variants, pricing, and inventory status.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled`

**OAuth Scope Required:** `cart:read`

Retrieve cart contents for a guest session. Requires X-Session-Id header.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled`

delete.description:
**OAuth Scope Required:** `cart:write`

Remove all items from cart. Requires X-Session-Id header.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled`

post.description:
**OAuth Scope Required:** `cart:write`

Add a product variant to the cart or update quantity if already exists.
Requires X-Session-Id header.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled`

400.description: Invalid request (missing session, invalid quantity, etc.)

patch.description:
**OAuth Scope Required:** `cart:write`

Update the quantity of an existing cart item. Requires X-Session-Id header.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled`

400.description: Invalid request (missing session, invalid quantity, etc.)

delete.description:
**OAuth Scope Required:** `cart:write`

Remove an item from the cart. Requires X-Session-Id header.

**Rate Limit:** 5000 requests/minute per client_id

**Feature Flag:** `headless.api.enabled`

get.description: Returns active consignors for the resolved tenant.

post.description: Creates a consignor profile scoped to the current tenant.

get.description: Retrieves a consignor by ID within the current tenant.

put.description:
Updates an existing consignor's information including contact details, commission rules,
and payout preferences. All fields from the request body replace the existing values.

delete.description: Soft deletes a consignor by setting status to `deleted`.

get.summary: List consignment items for a consignor
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of consignment items associated with a specific consignor.
Includes item details such as SKU, cost basis, received date, and current status.

put.description: Updates commission rate, status, or cost basis for a consignment item.

post.description: Creates a new intake batch to receive multiple consignment items.

Creates a new consignment item for the specified consignor. Associates the item with
a product variant and records cost basis, received date, and initial status.

get.summary: List payout batches for a consignor
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of payout batches for the specified consignor, including
batch totals, payout dates, and transaction details. Used for commission reconciliation.

post.description: Creates a payout batch for a consignor for a specific period.

get.description: Returns the authenticated consignor profile derived from the vendor JWT `consignor_id` claim.
Lists the authenticated consignor's items.

Returns all inventory locations for the current tenant. Includes warehouses,
stores, and other location types with stock tracking capability.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext

post.description:
Creates a new inventory location (warehouse, store, etc.) for the current tenant.
Location code must be unique within the tenant.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext

get.description:
Returns all inventory transfers for the current tenant, including pending,
in-transit, and completed transfers across all locations.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext

post.description:
Creates a new inventory transfer from source to destination location.
Validates stock availability, reserves inventory at source, and enqueues
background job for barcode label generation.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext
**Background Jobs:** Enqueues barcode generation job

201.description: Transfer created successfully, includes barcode job ID

400.description: Validation error (e.g., invalid quantity, same source/destination)

get.description:
Retrieves a transfer by ID within the current tenant, including all line items
and status information.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext

post.description:
Completes a transfer by marking it received, committing source reservations,
and adding inventory to destination location. Idempotent operation.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext
**Audit Logging:** All transfers are logged for inventory audit trail

Records a manual inventory adjustment with reason code for audit trail.
Used for cycle counts, damages, returns, shrinkage, etc.

**Authentication:** Admin role required
**Tenant Isolation:** Automatic via TenantContext
**Audit Logging:** All adjustments are logged with reason and user context

get.description: Lists payout batches visible to the authenticated consignor.

bearerAuth.description:
JWT token obtained from `/api/v1/auth/login` or `/api/v1/auth/refresh`.

**Token Claims:**
```json
{
  "sub": "user-uuid",
  "tenant_id": "tenant-uuid",
  "roles": ["admin"],
  "exp": 1704110400
}
```

**Token Lifecycle:**
- Access token: 15 minute expiry (short-lived, stateless)
- Refresh token: 30 day expiry (long-lived, stored in DB for revocation)

**Tenant Context:**
Tenant context is automatically injected from the `tenant_id` claim.
All API operations are scoped to this tenant.

**Note:** Role-based scopes like platform:admin are encoded in the JWT claims,
not as OAuth scopes. Access control is enforced at the application layer.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyAuth.description:
Long-lived API key for server-to-server integrations and headless commerce.

**Key Characteristics:**
- Scoped to specific tenant + permission set
- Managed via admin dashboard at `/admin/settings/api-keys`
- Can be rotated or revoked instantly
- Rate limits: 5000 requests/min (higher than user tokens)

**Typical Use Cases:**
- Custom storefronts (React, Vue, mobile apps)
- Backend integrations (inventory sync, order webhooks)
- Automated workflows (scheduled imports, bulk operations)

**Security:**
Keys are hashed in database (bcrypt). Store securely, never commit to version control.

oauthClientCredentials.description:
OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow for headless API access.

**Authentication:**
Obtain access token via POST to `/api/v1/oauth/token` with client credentials:
```
POST /api/v1/oauth/token
Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials&scope=catalog:read cart:read
```

**Rate Limits:**
Default: 5000 requests/minute per client_id (configurable per OAuth client)

**Management:**
OAuth clients are created and managed via admin dashboard at `/admin/settings/oauth-clients`.
Each client is scoped to a specific tenant and has a configurable set of allowed scopes.

**Security:**
- Client secrets are hashed (bcrypt) in database
- Clients can be instantly revoked by setting active=false
- All requests are logged with client_id + tenant_id for audit trails
- Tenant isolation enforced: client can only access data for its assigned tenant

**Feature Flag:** Requires `headless.api.enabled` feature flag to be enabled for tenant

IdempotencyKey.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Idempotency key for safe retries of non-idempotent operations (POST, DELETE).
If a request with the same idempotency key is replayed within 24 hours,
the original response is returned (no duplicate side effects).

**Recommended:** Always generate a unique UUID v4 per logical operation.
Store the key client-side and reuse on retry.

GuestSessionId.name: X-Session-Id
GuestSessionId.description:
Guest session identifier used to associate anonymous carts with the same browser/client.
If omitted, the API issues a `vs_session` HTTP-only cookie and returns the generated UUID in the response header.
Authenticated users can ignore this header because their carts are keyed to their account identity.

Production requests should rely on the HTTP `Host` header for automatic resolution.

Useful for:
- Multi-tenant testing (switch tenants without DNS changes)
- Platform admin impersonation
- Local development with ngrok/tunnels
